threepl.funcs

Class ArgListFunc

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.funcs.InbuiltFunc
      • threepl.funcs.ArgListFunc
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Constant

    public class ArgListFunc
extends InbuiltFunc
implements Constant
    An inbuilt function to pass lists, arrays or maps of arguments to the input or output argument list of a module, procedure or function. It should only be called within a module, procedure or function argument list. There are two arguments. The first argument is a list or array of key strings for the arguments to be passed. Blank entries signify an argument with no associated key. This argument may be omitted. The second argument is a list or array of arguments. If both arguments are present then they must be the same length. If a single argument is given it must be a map. The map keys and associated entries will be inserted as a key=value pair of arguments to the called subroutine.
